text.WLC: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
text.SYN: Воздайте Господу, сыны Божии, воздайте Господу славу и честь,
text.NAB: Of David. To you, LORD, I call; my Rock, do not be deaf to me. If you fail to answer me, I will join those who go down to the pit.
text.CEI: Di Davide. A te grido, Signore; non restare in silenzio, mio Dio, perché, se tu non mi parli, io sono come chi scende nella fossa.
text.LXX: Τοῦ Δαυείδ. Πρὸς σέ, Κύριε, ἐκέκραξα, ὁ θεός μου, μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς ἐπ’ ἑμοί· μή ποτε παρασιωπήσῃς ἐπ’ ἐμοὶ καὶ ὁμοιωθήσομαι τοῖς καταβαίνουσιν εἰς λάκκον.
text.VUL: Psalmus ipsi David. Ad te, Domine, clamabo ; Deus meus, ne sileas a me : nequando taceas a me, et assimilabor descendentibus in lacum.
text.DRA: A psalm for David himself. Unto thee will I cry, O Lord: O my God, be not thou silent to me: lest thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

text.WLC: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
text.SYN: воздайте Господу славу имени Его; поклонитесь Господу в благолепном святилище _Его._
text.NEO: Ecoute la voix de mes supplications, quand je crie vers toi, quand j’élève mes mains vers ton saint sanctuaire.
text.NAB: Hear the sound of my pleading when I cry to you, lifting my hands toward your holy place.
text.VAT_ES: Oye la voz de mi plegaria,
text.CEI: Ascolta la voce della mia supplica, quando ti grido aiuto, quando alzo le mie mani verso il tuo santo tempio.
text.LXX: εἰσάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ δέεσθαί με πρὸς σέ, ἐν τῷ με αἴρειν χεῖράς μου εἰς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου.
text.VUL: Exaudi, Domine, vocem deprecationis meæ dum oro ad te ; dum extollo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.
text.DRA: Hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication, when I pray to thee; when I lift up my hands to thy holy temple.

text.WLC: אַל תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
text.SYN: Глас Господень над водами; Бог славы возгремел, Господь над водами многими.
text.NEO: Ne m’emporte pas avec les méchants et les artisans d’iniquité, qui parlent de paix à leur prochain, et qui ont la malice dans le cœur.
text.NAB: Do not drag me off with the wicked, with those who do wrong, Who speak peace to their neighbors though evil is in their hearts.
text.VAT_ES: No me arrastres con los malvados
text.CEI: Non travolgermi con gli empi, con quelli che operano il male. Parlano di pace al loro prossimo, ma hanno la malizia nel cuore.
text.LXX: μὴ συνελκύσῃς μετὰ ἁμαρτωλῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου, καὶ μετὰ ἐργαζομένων ἀδικίαν μὴ συναπολέσῃς με, τῶν λαλούντων εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν πλησίον αὐτῶν, κακὰ δὲ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν.
text.VUL: Ne simul trahas me cum peccatoribus, et cum operantibus iniquitatem ne perdas me ; qui loquuntur pacem cum proximo suo, mala autem in cordibus eorum.
text.DRA: Draw me not away together with the wicked; and with the workers of iniquity destroy me not: Who speak peace with their neighbour, but evils are in their hearts.

text.WLC: תֶּן לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם׃
text.SYN: Глас Господа силен, глас Господа величествен.
text.NEO: Rends-leur selon leurs œuvres, et selon la malice de leurs actions ; rends-leur selon l’ouvrage de leurs mains, donne-leur le salaire qu’ils méritent.
text.NAB: Repay them for their deeds, for the evil that they do. For the work of their hands repay them; give them what they deserve.
text.CEI: Ripagali secondo la loro opera e la malvagità delle loro azioni. Secondo le opere delle loro mani, rendi loro quanto meritano.
text.LXX: δὸς αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν καὶ κατὰ τὴν πονηρίαν τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν· κατὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν δὸς αὐτοῖς, ἀπόδος τὸ ἀνταπόδομα αὐτῶν αὐτοῖς.
text.VUL: Da illis secundum opera eorum, et secundum nequitiam adinventionum ipsorum. Secundum opera manuum eorum tribue illis ; redde retributionem eorum ipsis.
text.DRA: Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their inventions. According to the works of their hands give thou to them: render to them their reward.

text.WLC: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם׃
text.SYN: Глас Господа сокрушает кедры; Господь сокрушает кедры Ливанские
text.NEO: Car ils ne prennent pas garde aux œuvres de Yahweh, à l’ouvrage de ses mains : il les détruira et ne les bâtira pas.
text.NAB: They pay no heed to the LORD'S works, to the deeds of God's hands. God will tear them down, never to be rebuilt.
text.VAT_ES: Ellos no valoran lo que hace el Señor
text.CEI: Poiché non hanno compreso l'agire del Signore e le opere delle sue mani, egli li abbatta e non li rialzi.
text.LXX: ὅτι οὐ συνῆκαν εἰς τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου καὶ εἰς τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ, καθελεῖς αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ μὴ οἰκοδομήσεις αὐτούς.
text.VUL: Quoniam non intellexerunt opera Domini, et in opera manuum ejus destrues illos, et non ædificabis eos.
text.DRA: Because they have not understood the works of the Lord, and the operations of his hands: thou shalt destroy them, and shalt not build them up.

text.WLC: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
text.SYN: и заставляет их скакать подобно тельцу, Ливан и Сирион, подобно молодому единорогу.
text.NEO: Béni soit Yahweh, car il a entendu la voix de mes supplications !
text.NAB: Blessed be the LORD, who has heard the sound of my pleading.
text.CEI: Sia benedetto il Signore, che ha dato ascolto alla voce della mia preghiera;
text.LXX: εὐλογητὸς Κύριος, ὅτι εἰσήκουσεν τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου.
text.VUL: Benedictus Dominus, quoniam exaudivit vocem deprecationis meæ.
text.DRA: Blessed be the Lord, for he hath heard the voice of my supplication.

text.WLC: יְהוָ֤ה עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ׃
text.NEO: Yahweh est ma force et mon bouclier ; en lui s’est confié mon cœur.
text.NAB: The LORD is my strength and my shield, in whom my heart trusted and found help. So my heart rejoices; with my song I praise my God.
text.VAT_ES: el Señor es mi fuerza y mi escudo,
text.CEI: il Signore è la mia forza e il mio scudo, ho posto in lui la mia fiducia; mi ha dato aiuto ed esulta il mio cuore, con il mio canto gli rendo grazie.
text.LXX: Κύριος βοηθός μου καὶ ὑπερασπιστής μου· ἐπ’ αὐτῷ ἤλπισεν ἡ καρδία μου, καὶ ἐβοηθήθην, καὶ ἀνέθαλεν ἡ σάρξ μου· καὶ ἐκ θελήματός μου ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ.
text.VUL: Dominus adjutor meus et protector meus ; in ipso speravit cor meum, et adjutus sum : et refloruit caro mea, et ex voluntate mea confitebor ei.
text.DRA: The Lord is my helper and my protector: in him hath my heart confided, and I have been helped. And my flesh hath flourished again, and with my will I will give praise to him.

text.WLC: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא׃
text.SYN: Глас Господа потрясает пустыню; потрясает Господь пустыню Кадес.
text.NEO: Yahweh est la force de son peuple, il est une forteresse de salut pour son Oint.
text.NAB: LORD, you are the strength of your people, the saving refuge of your anointed king.
text.VAT_ES: El Señor es la fuerza de su pueblo,
text.CEI: Il Signore è la forza del suo popolo, rifugio di salvezza del suo consacrato.
text.LXX: Κύριος κραταίωμα τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς τῶν σωτηρίων τοῦ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.
text.VUL: Dominus fortitudo plebis suæ, et protector salvationum christi sui est.
text.DRA: The Lord is the strength of his people, and the protector of the salvation of his anointed.

text.WLC: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה אֶת עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד הָעוֹלָֽם׃
text.SYN: Глас Господа разрешает от бремени ланей и обнажает леса; и во храме Его все возвещает о _Его_ славе.
text.NEO: Sauve ton peuple et bénis ton héritage ! Sois leur pasteur et porte-les à jamais !
text.NAB: Save your people, bless your inheritance; feed and sustain them forever!
text.VAT_ES: Salva a tu pueblo y bendice a tu herencia;
text.CEI: Salva il tuo popolo e la tua eredità benedici, guidali e sostienili per sempre.
text.LXX: σῶσον τὸν λαόν σου καὶ εὐλόγησον τὴν κληρονομίαν σου, καὶ ποίμανον αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔπαρον αὐτοὺς ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.
text.VUL: Salvum fac populum tuum, Domine, et benedic hæreditati tuæ ; et rege eos, et extolle illos usque in æternum.
text.DRA: Save, O Lord, thy people, and bless thy inheritance: and rule them and exalt them for ever.
